basic_profile.bio: I'm a 16-year-old high school student from Southern California. I spend most of my free time exploring video games, especially Grand Theft Auto, and I'm really into the lore of dark fantasy books, like 'The First Law' series. I recently moved to a new neighborhood, which is why I'm trying out Reddit to connect with people who share my interests. I'm still figuring out what I want to do career-wise, but I'm leaning towards something tech-related. I’m usually online during the evenings after school, around 6-10 PM PST. Single and not really looking right now, just focusing on friendships.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of video game mechanics and glitches, mostly from watching YouTube tutorials and spending countless hours experimenting in games like GTA. My interest in politics is new, sparked by recent debates at school, but I’m still learning the ropes. Fantasy literature is another passion of mine, inspired by recommendations from friends and online forums.
